notes.title: Fixed glitching audio
notes.content:
Version 1.1.6:

- Fixed glitching audio when a lot of enemies are on screen.
- Improve player hit-point UI.

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed movement speed of the player in the diagonal direction.
- Fixed sound glitching when a lot of enemies are on screen.

notes.title: 13 Aug 2024. minor fixes.
notes.content: - Move `hit point ui` to the `Top` layer to improve player visibility.
